notes.title: Quiet Farm playthrough with Crytivo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41289681/68a35aa3bfd26b8e51bd622ef8bd923245b26012.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! 
Join us on [b]February 24th at 10am PST / 7 pm CET / 1pm EST[/b] for a livestream where we will be showcasing our new upcoming game Quiet Farm! Quiet Farm is a cute, funny and crazy cow simulator game with aliens and weird creatures. 

Join us, ask any questions and enjoy the Stream! We are looking forward to see you soon. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771040/Quiet_Farm/
